tool.name: oatk

param.name: kmer_size
param.label: K-mer Size
param.help: K-mer size used by Syncasm for building the assembly graph. Larger values are suitable for accurate long reads such as PacBio HiFi.

param.name: smer_size
param.label: S-mer Size
param.help: Syncmer size used for k-mer sampling. This value to be no larger than 31.

param.name: min_kmer_coverage
param.label: Minimum K-mer Coverage
param.help: K-mers below this value are removed from the assembly graph. This is an important parameter for organelle genome assembly, as higher values help filter out nuclear sequences and NUMTs. As an empirical instruction, this parameter can be set as 5-10 times the value of nuclear sequence coverage.

param.name: min_arc_coverage
param.label: Minimum Arc Coverage
param.help: Relative threshold (0-1) to keep or prune connections between sequences

validator.message: Enter a number optionally followed by K, M, or G

param.name: max_bubble_size
param.label: Maximum Bubble Size
param.help: Maximum size of bubbles (alternative paths) to resolve during graph cleaning.

param.name: max_tip_size
param.label: Maximum Tip Size
param.help: Maximum size of tips (dead ends) to resolve during graph cleaning.

param.name: weak_crosslink
param.label: Maximum Relative Edge Coverage for Weak Crosslink
param.help: Maximum relative coverage allowed for weak cross-links to be removed during graph cleaning.

param.name: unzip_rounds
param.label: Maximum Unzip Rounds
param.help: Maximum number of rounds to attempt unzipping the assembly graph.

param.name: disable_read_ec
param.label: Disable Read Error Correction?
param.help: Disable read error correction during assembly.

param.name: annotation_hmm_mito
param.label: Mitochondria HMM Profile Database
param.help: You must supply at least one HMM Profile Database (mitochondria or plastids). These can be obtained from OatkDB (see help below this tool for link)

param.name: annotation_hmm_plastid
param.label: Plastid HMM Profile Database
param.help: You must supply at least one HMM Profile Database (mitochondria or plastids). These can be obtained from OatkDB (see help below this tool for link)

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Batch Size
param.help: Number of reads to process in each batch.

param.name: prefer_circular_path
param.label: Prefer Circular Path Threshold
param.help: Prefer circular path to longest if >= FLOAT sequence covered

param.name: min_annotation_score
param.label: Minimum Annotation Score
param.help: Minimum score for a core gene to be considered valid.

param.name: max_evalue
param.label: Maximum E-value
param.help: Maximum E-value for a core gene to be considered valid.

param.name: min_core_gene_gain
param.label: Minimum Core Gene Gain (General, Mitochondria)
param.help: Minimum number of core gene gain required. Format: INT or INT,INT (second value for mitochondria).

param.name: min_seq_length
param.label: Minimum length of a Singleton Sequence to Keep
param.help: Minimum length of sequences retained as singletons

param.name: min_seq_coverage
param.label: Minimum Sequence Coverage
param.help: Minimum coverage a sequence must have relative to its subgraph average

param.name: max_copy_number
param.label: Maximum Copy Number to consider
param.help: Maximum copy number considered for any sequence

param.name: edge_coverage_tag
param.label: Edge Coverage Tag in GFA File

param.name: kmer_coverage_tag
param.label: K-mer Coverage Tag in GFA File

tool.help:
**Oatk** is designed for de novo assembly of complex plant organelle genomes using PacBio HiFi data. It can also be used to assemble other simple organelle genomes such as animal mitochondria.
**Annotation Files** HMM Profile databases can be obtained from `OatkDB`_
**Toolkit Components**: - **syncasm**: A de novo HiFi read assembler using a sparse de Bruijn graph constructed from closed syncmers (Edgar, R. 2021). - **hmmannot**: A HMMER wrapper for annotating organelle sequences using a pre-built HMM profile database (available at OatkDB). - **pathfinder**: Parses and circularises organelle genomes from assemblies by integrating HMM annotations with assembly graph structure. - **oatk**: Runs syncasm, hmmannot, and pathfinder collectively.
**Auxiliary Tools**: - **path_to_fasta**: Extracts FASTA sequences from a GFA file given a path. - **rotate**: Rotates a circular sequence to a specified position.
This Galaxy wrapper provides a user-friendly interface to configure and run Oatk for organelle genome assembly.
.. _OatkDB: https://github.com/c-zhou/OatkDB
